_about: Bond fund duration – automatic monthly collection (tools/duration_auto.py, .github/workflows/duration.yml, 19th of each month, no AI). Public links only. urls are tried in order; {YYYYMM}/{YYYYMMDD} = month end being collected; copy=true marks a broker copy. value = label regex, the first number after it on the same line is taken. date = regex with the document date in group 1. Owner's own links live in /mnt/project-files/funds_dd/duration/sources.json – keep both in step.
